# Chef Hong

> Chinese Food Truck in Austin, Texas. A husband-and-wife food truck by UT. Roujiamo, liangpi and dumplings, hot, fresh and generous.

- Areas: Austin, Del Valle, Creedmoor, Manor, Bee Cave
- Offers: Roujiamo, the Chinese hamburger; Liangpi cold noodles; Noodles, dumplings & rice
